IC1: Known hypersensitivity to tetracycline [OR], doxycycline [OR] or azithromycin
IC2: Administration of doxycycline, [OR] azithromycin, [OR] chloramphenicol, [OR] rifampicin, [OR] or tetracycline during the preceding 7 days
IC4: Patients with myasthenia gravis or [OR] systemic lupus erythematosus
IC5: Patients with an established infection (di [AND]agnostic test required) e.g. acute malaria, de [OR]ngue, le [OR]ptospirosis, ty [OR]phoid, Ja [OR]panese encephalitis etc.
IC6: Current TB or T [OR]B treatment in = 6 months (contain active antibiotics against Orientia spp.)
IC7: Current HAART use f [OR]or HIV, long term use of immunosuppressants (e.g. steroids, chem [OR]otherapy, TNF- [OR]inhibitors and related agents)
IC8: Patients with severe disease whom the clinical team feel their condition necessitates the need for additional scrub typhus treatment beyond the allocated antibiotic treatment assigned at randomization (e.g. IV chloramphenicol and/or PO/NG rifampicin)
